definition.formation: Cartesian 1st x 2nd x 3rd excluding repeated riders; two sets may overlap, unique 3連単 combinations purchased once
definition.synthetic_price_interpretation: Common decimal payout multiple only under EXACT fractional dutching; this experiment's actual primary ROI buys EACH unique ticket for 100 yen, not equal-payout stakes
definition.true_evaluation: 100 yen x |union| stakes, 100 yen x outcome odds if exact order is in union; no partial-match score
definition.baseline: Unmodified earlier market-marginal top-k base, plus seven original fixed shift/hold masks; all sizes generated by old algorithm. This does not prove global formation optimality.
definition.threshold_policy: Only bet on historical final-odds synthetic_odds >= threshold AND total unique points <= point cap, no post-result conditions
definition.train_selections: Most profitable historical ROI among preregistered grid with at least 200 training entries and 25/year. Skip if selected training ROI <=100%. Evaluate next year untouched by THIS selection.

chronological_selections.controls: Parametric grid fixed in code; all candidate training ROC selection retrospective. No test outcome used to pick winner.

limits: All prices are historical FINAL odds, not T-15 observable odds; profitable segment does NOT establish live tradability.
Past research has already examined these historical years. Even test years are not a genuinely untouched dataset.
No betting decisions use outcomes; but group selection from the same historical outcomes is susceptible to multiple-testing and post-hoc bias.
Market-only formation construction cannot by itself create an independent predictive edge; test is for observed conditional mispricing.
The minimum threshold 3.0 is a tested entry limit; bins below 3.0 included only for descriptive controls.
No risk-adjusted capital allocation or executable integer-yen dutching is validated.
A strong theoretical synthetic odds multiplier is not the actual payout multiple for equal stakes on unequal-odds combinations.
No model, purchased ticket strategy, or production code updated.
